name: 3D Print
description: Put Library items or your model on your printer's bed, position them in the view and send them to the printer, with no exporting. Sends over USB, or to Klipper, OctoPrint or PrusaLink on your network. CadCraft's basic slicer comes with it; Kiri:Moto, PrusaSlicer and OrcaSlicer are add-ons of their own.
author: CadCraft
